groups.saying_opens: لو أن رجلا، ابتاع ثمرا قبل أن يبدو
لا تتبايعوا الثمر حتى يبدو صلاحها

notes: two sayings: Zuhri's own opinion (saying 1, ends at Zuhri) and the Prophet's prohibition with its own isnad through Salim (saying 2); the second group keeps the shared head
«أخبرني سالم بن عبد الله عن ابن عمر» : Salim's transmission is the second saying's own chain
